comparison.objective: Remove a restraining bar and open a drawer; candidate adjusts and locks an angular gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Linear bar extraction and drawer pulling versus coaxial driver/wrench coordination and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Bar removed and drawer opened at least 18 cm versus stop angle, nut retention, repeatable cycling, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both involve articulated equipment, but the tested abilities and terminal states differ materially.
